I can not suggest The Elder Scrolls Online more. It is an amazingly well crafted game for where it started. I played back in the beta tests and it was terrible. ZOS has defiantly picked up the pace and put the shine on.

  • Great story arcs and quest lines. (There is no reason to just rush through the text and -everything- is voice acted)
  • Fun, interactive combat. (I'm not a big fan of point'n'click styles like WoW)
  • You aren't bound by your class. (There are 4 classes and they can do anything you want them to)
  • Crafting items is actually meaningful. (Crafted items will almost always be stronger than drops, and it's not hard it get someone to craft things for you if that isn't your thing)
  • No pay-to-win. (Cosmetics in the cash shop)
  • PvP is a 3 faction war, multiple instances to fight in. (Players can fighter over territory and more. Also PvP is not required if you don't like it.)

Other than ESO, if you have much time on your hands, I'd suggest EVE Online.
